description: The horizontal stacked bar chart, titled "QA-2," illustrates the distribution of three evaluation outcomes for two specific categories. The vertical axis displays the categories, labeled from top to bottom as "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0" and "RedWhale (our)." There is no horizontal value axis, axis label, or scale with tick marks present; instead, numerical values are annotated directly onto the individual bar segments, and the total visual length of each stacked bar is uniform. Each horizontal bar is divided into three color-coded segments arranged sequentially from left to right. According to the legend at the bottom of the chart, the dark purple segment represents "Correct," the medium blue segment represents "Partially Correct," and the light blue segment represents "Incorrect." For the "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0" category, the bar consists of a Correct segment valued at 92.9, a Partially Correct segment at 2.9, and an Incorrect segment at 4.3. For the "RedWhale (our)" category, the segments are valued at 95.7 for Correct (the longest individual segment in the chart), 1.4 for Partially Correct (the shortest segment), and 2.9 for Incorrect. The y-axis categories do not follow an alphabetical sort. Visual emphasis is applied through the numerical annotations centered within each segment, which use white text on the dark purple and medium blue segments, and dark text on the light blue segments to maintain contrast.
